When server credentials are created with the `requireClientCertificate` option set to `false`, `getAuthContext` does not distinguish between authorized and unauthorized certificates in its return value. This can create improper authentication vulnerabilities for `@grpc/grpc-js` users who use the result of `getAuthContext` for authentication.

In particular, `@grpc/grpc-js-xds` can both set the `requireClientCertificate` option to `false` and use the return value of `getAuthContext` for RBAC authentication in some configurations.

### Patches

This vulenrability is fixed in 1.13.6 and 1.14.5.

### Workarounds
`@grpc/grpc-js` users using `getAuthContext` this way can avoid this problem by setting `requireClientCertificate` to `true`. `@grpc/grpc-js-xds` users using RBAC can avoid this by setting the `require_client_certificate` field to `true` in the DownstreamTlsContext in the xDS configuration.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00208, "percentile": 0.09723}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-30T15:35:53Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-101916"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-09-28T21:17:13Z", "published_at": "2026-09-30T15:35:53Z", "references": ["https://github.com/grpc/grpc-node/security/advisories/GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-101916", "https://github.com/grpc/grpc-node/commit/2a84ec8b01b9db68ed9d2b117a53a81449edb8ee", "https://github.com/grpc/grpc-node/commit/b4e0079c6d22a2adedfcac748e0bc083f783bc7c", "https://github.com/grpc/grpc-node/releases/tag/@grpc/grpc-js%401.14.5", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/grpc/grpc-node/security-advisories/GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/grpc/grpc-node", "summary": "@grpc/grpc-js: In certain configurations, getAuthContext can return unauthorized certificates as though they were authorized", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-30T15:35:57Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.13.6", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@grpc/grpc-js"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 1.13.6"}, {"first_patched_version": "1.14.5", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@grpc/grpc-js"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 1.14.0, < 1.14.5"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
